rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-backed optimizations: concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), custom timeouts on all jobs (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), and Docker layer caching via cache-scope for dependency management. The remaining candidate patterns either have contraindications (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST: matrix jobs explicitly use fail-fast: false to preserve full diagnostics and artifact uploads per entry; P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: only the lint-python job runs on the host runner and installs a single pinned binary (ruff), yielding minimal benefit not commensurate with the Go-module evidence), or are inapplicable (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE, P-LIT-BAZEL-*, etc.). No optimization meets the threshold of clear, directly supported applicability for this workflow.
